validation_rules: consume an explicit run-owned binding that partitions every pinned source-lock family into selected or unselected
re-verify every selected immutable snapshot manifest, file hash, license, normalized record schema and source lineage offline
copy selected manifests, licenses and individual records into the immutable run attempt and publish their hashes
reject missing or duplicate record identities, changed bytes, absent control text and mixed snapshot generations
unselected families remain explicit coverage gaps
reference records and mappings are navigation material, never compliance proof, findings, severity, or runtime observations
